research_findings.name: Basilica of the Sacred Heart, Paray-le-Monial

operational_gates: Screen all 74 original rows together while preserving both candidate IDs on the El Quinche row.
An inherited coordinate, map search result, website excerpt or name similarity alone does not verify a church building.
Confirm first-party Catholic ownership/identity, exact OSM way with church footprint (or independently certified site geometry), then deduplicate against current canonical Place and source_ref.
Separately identify physical churches, chapels, religious campus grounds, archaeological monuments, non-Catholic custodians and genuinely ambiguous scopes.
Resolve existing-Place reuse or geometry upgrade before creating new Place IDs; preserve frozen IDs and historical release ledger.
Keep Bonaria, Materdomini and Sacra di San Michele protected until their exact building-versus-complex boundaries are independently established.
This file is NOT appended to sacred-places-live-release-chain; published counts remain 457/755/145 and no Mass schedule, image right, relic claim or pilgrim service is implied.
The six matched ways are exact individual named building records and are not automatically promoted by this research-only PR; the current live registry has no matching geo.source_ref values.
